newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas firms on Swiss stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Danzas firms on Swiss stock exchange.

text.p: Shares in Swiss freight forwarding concern Danzas AG firmed on rising volume at midday, with some buying possibly tied to talk that banks were planning road shows and studies on the company.
A spokeswoman at Danzas said the company planned no press announcements about either its results or a current restructuring. The company has also made no official announcements about any road shows.
Danzas registered shares were up 42 Swiss francs in early afternoon trade, at 1,372.0.
Danzas rose in spite of a general weaker tone in the Swiss market.
Other traders said that Danzas was helped by an ongoing restructuring at the concern, which was seen as starting to have a positive impact.
Traders said there was also speculation that Danzas will benefit from a European freight-handling cooperation with U.S. forwarder United Parcel Service of America Inc (UPS) set up earlier this year.
One large Swiss bank was said to have been a particularly aggressive buyer, traders said.
